latest_deployment_readiness_repair.repair: Keep the exact cold route and 20-second retry cadence, extend only the revision-readiness deadline from 180 seconds to 480 seconds, and extend the public job timeout from 12 to 15 minutes. All downstream Step 4 acceptance checks remain unchanged.
